individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of pseudocoloured micrographs (time-lapse images), not a plot, so the check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of normalized fluorescence intensity vs time (with fitted model curves) and insets of the same type; each plotted marker already represents an individual measured data point/time-point, and these are line/scatter-type plots which are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A shows micrographs without any quantitative error bars.

FAIL - The insets show average early time-point responses with vertical error bars on the data points, but the caption never states what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI), so they are not adequately defined.
